first:5f8821095b3f958c.body:
I am applying for the Graduate Data Analyst role at Example Analytics. I have completed an MSc in Computer Science at Example Institute (2026), and my strongest match for this position is my Synthetic Dataset Explorer project, in which I wrote SQL queries to summarise a synthetic dataset and used Python to validate its records.

In that project I worked in Python and SQL throughout. On the SQL side, I wrote queries to summarise the dataset, which reflects the SQL querying this role involves. On the Python side, I used the language to validate records in the dataset, giving me direct practice in applying Python to data. I also use Git alongside Python and SQL, so I am used to working with version control as part of my programming.

My MSc coursework in Databases and Software Engineering supports this practical work. The databases element underpins my SQL, while software engineering informs how I structure and write my Python code. Together with the project, this gives me a foundation in the two languages at the centre of the role: writing SQL queries and working with data in Python.

I would welcome the chance to bring this combination of SQL querying, Python work and a computer science degree to the operations reporting described in the posting. Thank you for considering my application.
